text: 问：美东时间10月7日，美贸易代表办公室（USTR）发布公告称，近期美国召集14个经济体高级官员举行会议，共同签署发布应对所谓“结构性产能和生产过剩”问题的部长级联合声明。请问商务部对此有何评论？ 答：我们注意到有关情况。中方已在不同场合多次阐明关于所谓“产能过剩”问题的看法，并于今年7月专门发布了有关立场文件。 中方一贯认为，看待产能问题要秉持全面、客观、公正的态度，不能出于对自身产业竞争力和市场地位的担忧，将经贸问题政治化。中方反对个别国家以所谓“产能过剩”为名，行贸易保护主义之实，这只会扰乱全球经贸秩序和产供链稳定，给世界经济增长带来长期风险。如果
text_en: Q: On October 7, US Eastern Time, the Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR) issued an announcement stating that the United States recently convened senior officials from 14 economies for a meeting and jointly signed and issued a ministerial joint statement addressing the so-called "structural overcapacity and production" issue. What is the Ministry of Commerce's comment on this? A: We have noted the relevant situation. China has stated its views on the so-called "overcapacity" issue on multiple occasions and issued a dedicated position paper on this in July this year. China has always held that the overcapacity issue should be viewed in a comprehensive, objective and fair manner, and economic and trade issues should not be politicized out of concern for one's own industrial competitiveness and market position. China opposes certain countries using the pretext of so-called "overcapacity" to practice trade protectionism, which will only disrupt the global economic and trade order and the stability of industrial and supply chains and bring long-term risks to world economic growth.
